parts.name: Root
parts.description: A native input element. It has a modality-aware focus state, and it shows its validation state in data attributes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input, with the native attribute.

props.name: readonly
props.description: The native `readonly` attribute. The component also sets `aria-readonly`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as not valid. The component sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`.

props.name: required
props.description: The native `required` attribute. The component also sets `aria-required`.

props.name: value
props.description: The value. You can bind it.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the element has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value is marked invalid.
